history.text: Fenwick Pay merchants report double ledger entries in Tallyhop after webhook retries. Find the root cause and fix it. Do not touch production data without asking me.

Traced it. The webhook consumer inserts a ledger entry before it records the delivery id, so a retry that arrives inside the same second passes the idempotency check and posts again. I will add a unique index on delivery id plus a guarded insert, then size the damage.
